channel.description: Stay updated on the latest news and events happening in the RPI community.

item.title: Fellowship Info Session to Highlight Competitions for Grad School Salary and Tuition: Sept. 16th, 10AM
item.description: Competitive fellowships provide salary and tuition for masters and PhD students. Seniors and graduate students will learn how to find and apply to appropriate programs that will fund fall 2027 and beyond. Programs are available for all stages of your academic career. International students are welcome! Email madige@rpi or Register at https://surveys.rpi.edu/jfe/form/SV_6L3FFwv0qCROrvE
item.author: Students

item.title: Lally AI Academy Applications Now Open
item.description: Have an AI idea you want to bring to life? The Lally AI Academy is a 30-day, hands-on sprint where student teams build and deploy live AI-powered products with a $500 budget, mentorship, and professional-grade tools. No coding background required! Teams must include at least one Lally student. Applications for Cohort 2 close September 15. Apply Today!
item.author: Students

item.title: How to Start Your Graduate School Application
item.description: Date: Wednesday, September 16, 2026 3:00 PM - 4:00 PM - Preparing to apply to graduate school? The Writing Lab is offering a workshop that introduces key strategies for writing an effective Statement of Purpose (SOP) or personal statement. Learn how to begin the writing process, organize your ideas, highlight your experiences and goals, and compose compelling application essays.

item.title: OGE Dissertation and Thesis Workshop
item.description: Date: Wednesday, September 16, 2026 12:00 PM - 1:30 PM - Learn the basics of correct thesis organization and format, appropriate paper attribution and reference citation styles—plus a review of the most commonly found mistakes and ways to avoid them. This workshop is for any student who will be writing a MS thesis or PhD dissertation. Bring your questions! item.title: Webinar: Is a Faculty Job Right for You?
item.description: Date: Wednesday, September 16, 2026 12:00 PM - 12:45 PM - Many PhDs and postdocs enter their program with the goal of becoming a professor. But today’s academic job market is highly competitive, and a tenure-track role may not be the right fit for everyone. As your values, life circumstances, and career goals evolve, it is important to reassess what career paths align with your personal and professional needs. Join this webinar where we’ll walk you through the key factors to consider as you…

item.title: Computer Science Colloquia - Sabrina Kirrane
item.description: Date: Tuesday, September 15, 2026 4:00 AM - 5:00 AM - Information disorders, such as dis-, mis-, and malinformation, can lead to societal and economic harm. They are rapidly spread, extensively consumed on the web, and represent a threat to democracy. The aim of this work is to better understand the state of the art regarding information disorder detection approaches by conducting a reproducibility study and a cross-data and cross-model comparative analysis. we provide takeaways concerning…

item.title: EMPAC Launches Interface, a New Series Connecting Artistic Practice and Scientific Research
item.description: Monthly conversations bring artists, engineers, scientists, and designers together to explore quantum physics, immersive audio, cognitive science, robotics, mixed reality, AI, and previsualization TROY, N.Y. — The Experimental Media and Performing Arts Center (EMPAC) at Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute (RPI) launches Interface, a monthly series of talks examining how artists and researchers approach questions they do not yet know how to answer.
item.author: Community

item.title: JEC East-Side Elevated Walkway Update
item.description: Construction continues on the elevated walkway between the Darrin Communications Center (DCC) and the Jonsson Engineering Center (JEC). One half of the south side is anticipated to reopen for pedestrian traffic by August 28. The north half and area beneath the walkway will remain closed. Periodic full closures may be necessary. Please follow posted signage and alternate pedestrian routes. Completion is anticipated in November.
item.author: Community

item.title: Intellectual Property and Technology Licensing (IPTL) Informational Session | Septermber 16 at 11:00 am
item.description: Are you working on groundbreaking research? Are you curious about what happens to your ideas, inventions, research, and software at RPI? Join the Intellectual Property & Technology Licensing (IPTL) team for an informational session on the basics of intellectual property. We’ll cover patents, copyrights, invention disclosures, commercialization, and when you should contact IPTL. Join Us on Wednesday September 16th at 11:00am. Online event. Registration required.

item.title: RPI at Work Hosts Certificate Review on September 16
item.description: Date: Wednesday, September 16, 2026 12:00 PM - 12:30 PM - Join RPI at Work’s Aric Krause, Ph.D., in a 30-minute information session highlighting the whole range of RPI’s online, project-based graduate certificate programs. These certificates are three courses in length, developing targeted ability groups, and can be completed in as little as seven months. Please register if you plan to attend.

item.title: Division of Human Resources Professional Development Seminar- “RPI MAX: Setting Goals and Reviewing Results”
item.description: Date: Thursday, September 17, 2026 9:00 AM - 11:00 AM - This seminar will establish the positive effect of transforming the traditional role of planner and evaluator solely from the people-leader to a shared responsibility between leader and direct report. Leaders will experience how to develop and use effective SMART goals to help them, and their employees track progress and accurately evaluate outcomes. In addition, the fundamentals of an impactful performance discussion and the three phased…
item.author: Faculty and Staff

item.title: Grant Writing 101
item.description: Date: Wednesday, September 16, 2026 2:00 PM - 3:00 PM - At this workshop, the Office of the Vice President for Research will talk through avoiding common pitfalls when writing grants as well as other research reports. The workshop will focus on how best to tailor grant proposals so that reviewers understand the impact and significance of your proposed research; how to use AI appropriately when writing; formatting tricks to make the most of your page limits; and grammatical tips.

item.title: Innovation Excellence Award — Who is making RPI better?
item.description:
Who is your “why don’t we try this?” person? The colleague who finds solutions. Challenges assumptions. Makes processes better. Turns an idea into something that actually works. Shine a spotlight on them with a nomination for the Innovation Excellence Award!
